configuration.fixture: Deterministic synthetic RGBA gradients; no user page or document data.
limitations: No forced GC; heap samples are observational and include instrumentation.
Counters count API calls and requested encoded pixels, not live canvas memory.
Timing includes Playwright/CDP overhead; no warmup or performance pass/fail thresholds.
Each root runs in a fresh temporary browser profile; baseline diagnostics may be unavailable.
